sorte.meaning: kind / sort (de sorte que: so that)

sortir.meaning: to go out / leave / step outside

tais.meaning: be quiet / hold one's peace (se taire)

tour.meaning: turn / trick / tower (à tour de bras: with all one's might)

train.meaning: pace / train (en train de: in the middle of)

égal.meaning: equal (c'est égal: it makes no difference)

égard.meaning: regard / respect (à l'égard de: with regard to)
